{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float: remove commas and cast
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for internal test orders (value 999999.99)
internal_test_mask = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)
internal_test_count = internal_test_mask.sum()
print(f'Number of internal test orders: {internal_test_count}')

# Filter out internal test orders
df_filtered = df[~internal_test_mask]
print(f'Number of rows after excluding internal test orders: {len(df_filtered)}')

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed_filtered = df_filtered[df_filtered['status'] == 'completed']
print(f'Number of completed orders after excluding internal test orders: {len(df_completed_filtered)}')

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = df_completed_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f'Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue}')"}
